data.description: A New Chapter of Luxury Awaits at Nara, The Valley

data.answer: Nara Townhouses Emaar will be strategically located near Al-Ain Road (E66), ensuring seamless connectivity to major road networks across Dubai. This vibrant community will offer an array of lifestyle and fitness amenities, including lush green spaces, playgrounds, parks, retail areas, beach zones, and state-of-the-art sports facilities, all designed to provide residents with a well-rounded and dynamic living experience.

NARA Townhouses will introduce a modern residential community featuring 3 and 4-bedroom single-row townhouses, each designed to blend contemporary aesthetics with functionality. With three distinct architectural styles, these homes will offer residents a unique and comfortable living experience tailored to different lifestyle preferences.

Aston Townhouses

NARA Townhouses Floor Plans will include the Aston collection, which is designed for those who appreciate contemporary architecture. These homes will feature expansive windows that invite natural light while offering serene garden views. Available in 3 and 4-bedroom layouts, Aston townhouses will provide a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces.

Palma Townhouses

Nara Townhouses Emaar will also present the Palma townhouses, which will embrace minimalist design aesthetics with a refined elegance. These residences will be distinguished by their spacious layouts, large windows for fresh air and natural illumination, and uninterrupted garden views. Residents will also enjoy direct access to parks and recreational spaces.

Charm Townhouses

Nara at The Valley, Dubai will introduce the exclusive Charm townhouses, which will feature fresh white porticos and a modern architectural appeal. These limited-edition homes, available in 3 and 4-bedroom layouts, will offer a balance of style and comfort. With direct access to parks and beautifully landscaped gardens, these residences will provide a peaceful yet sophisticated living environment.

Renting a Property in Emaar Nara Townhouses

Since Nara is an off-plan development in Dubai, there will be no properties available for rent at this stage. Upon completion, this premium community will offer a variety of high-quality rental options for those seeking a contemporary lifestyle within The Valley.

Buying a Property in Nara Townhouses, The Valley

Prospective buyers will have the opportunity to invest in a meticulously planned community, with prices starting at approximately AED 1.34M. The payment plan will be structured for convenience, with a 12% down payment required at booking, followed by installments leading up to the estimated completion in December 2024. 

The final settlement will account for 50% of the total cost, ensuring a flexible and manageable purchase process for investors and homeowners alike.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Nara at The Valley?

data.answer:
Life in Emaar Nara Townhouses will offer a harmonious blend of modern living and nature-inspired surroundings. This thoughtfully designed community will provide residents with premium amenities, scenic landscapes, and a peaceful yet vibrant lifestyle.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Nara Townhouses

NARA Townhouses, The Valley, will be designed with residents' convenience in mind, offering dedicated parking spaces for each townhouse. The NARA Townhouses Floor Plans will ensure ample parking facilities to accommodate residents' vehicles comfortably.​

Regarding public transportation, while current options near The Valley are developing, the community's proximity to major thoroughfares like Al-Ain Road (E66) will facilitate easy commutes to key areas. As Dubai's infrastructure continues to evolve, enhancements in public transit services are anticipated, further improving connectivity for NARA Townhouses, The Valley residents.

Location & Nearby Areas

Nara at The Valley, Dubai will be strategically positioned to offer residents seamless connectivity to key areas across the city. The community will be just 13 minutes away from DAMAC Hills 2, providing easy access to a well-established residential neighborhood with golf courses and recreational facilities. 

A 16-minute drive from The Villa will ensure proximity to a vibrant community known for its upscale villas and tranquil surroundings. Additionally, Academic City will be only 17 minutes away, making it an ideal location for families seeking access to renowned educational institutions. With well-connected road networks, residents of Nara at The Valley will enjoy effortless travel to Dubai’s prime destinations.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Nara Townhouses Emaar

data.answer:
Life at Nara Townhouses Emaar will be filled with leisure and recreation, offering residents a variety of activities to enjoy. From lush green spaces to sports facilities and retail hubs, the community will cater to a dynamic and well-balanced lifestyle.

Beaches Near Emaar Nara Townhouses

Residents of Emaar Nara Townhouses will have easy access to The Valley’s Golden Beach, a sprawling 30,000 sq. m. waterfront destination designed for relaxation and leisure. As part of the master community, this scenic beach will offer a range of exciting activities for both children and adults, including splash parks, playgrounds, and various water-based fun. 

With dedicated F&B outlets providing light snacks and refreshments, Golden Beach will be the perfect spot for residents to unwind and enjoy sunny afternoons just moments from home.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Residents of Nara Townhouses Emaar will enjoy a vibrant and active lifestyle with access to numerous outdoor and fitness amenities. The community will feature a dedicated community centre, picnic areas, pocket parks, gardens, playgrounds, and a retail area, ensuring a well-rounded living experience. For those who love staying active, outdoor fitness zones, a beach area, sports courts, and cycling and running tracks will be readily available.

At Nara Townhouses The Valley, residents will have access to Sports Village, a sprawling 20,000 sq. m. facility designed for fitness enthusiasts. It will feature an outdoor gym, well-maintained bicycle and running tracks, and multi-sports courts for various athletic activities. This space will promote a healthy and dynamic lifestyle within the community.

For families, Kids’ Dale will span 10,000 sq. m., providing an engaging environment where children can enjoy rock climbing, explore an archaeological play area, and experience an amphitheater for fun performances. This space will be designed to nurture creativity and adventure in a safe and enjoyable setting.

The Pavilion will be an expansive 33,000 sq. m. retreat, perfect for relaxation and wellness activities. Residents will have the opportunity to unwind with sunset yoga sessions, navigate through a beautifully designed maze, take in scenic views from an observation tower, or relax in the tranquil Zen & Oasis garden, making it an ideal place for rejuvenation.

Community Events

Residents of Nara Townhouses The Valley will experience a vibrant community atmosphere with a variety of events and gatherings designed to foster connections. From seasonal celebrations and family-friendly festivals to outdoor movie nights and wellness sessions, the neighborhood will offer numerous opportunities for social engagement. 
Nara Townhouses Emaar will also host community markets, fitness challenges, and creative workshops, ensuring that residents can actively participate in a dynamic and enriching lifestyle within The Valley.

Attractions and Landmarks

Residents of Emaar Nara Townhouses will have easy access to some of Dubai’s top entertainment and sports venues. The Sevens Stadium, a renowned multi-purpose sports facility, will be just a short drive away, hosting major sporting events, concerts, and cultural festivals throughout the year.

For a thrilling experience, IMG Worlds of Adventure will be only 18 minutes away, featuring an array of 3D rides, cinema halls, and themed attractions that cater to families and adventure seekers. This world-class entertainment hub will ensure an exciting lifestyle for residents of Emaar Nara Townhouses.

While Emaar Nara Townhouses will offer a premium lifestyle with modern townhouses and world-class amenities, prospective residents should keep in mind that it is an off-plan development, meaning construction is still in progress. As a result, some community features and infrastructure may take time to be fully operational.

more_info.question: FAQs About Nara at The Valley

data.answer:
What types of properties will be available in Nara at The Valley?

Nara will feature 3 and 4-bedroom single-row townhouses, each designed with a contemporary architectural style to suit different preferences.

Will there be schools or educational facilities within the community?

While The Valley does not yet have dedicated schools, several well-established educational institutions will be located a short drive away in nearby areas.

Will the community have pet-friendly spaces?

Yes, Nara will be a pet-friendly community, with open green spaces and pedestrian-friendly pathways, making it an ideal environment for pet owners.

What sustainability features will Nara offer?

The community is being designed with eco-friendly principles, incorporating green spaces, energy-efficient lighting, and pedestrian-friendly pathways to promote sustainable living.

When is the expected handover date for Nara townhouses?

The estimated completion and handover of Nara townhouses are set for Q4 2024, providing future homeowners with a well-planned and modern residential community.
